plugin.name: Dialog Tune
plugin.description: Dialog Tune applies a targeted edit to an AI reply or to your own draft. Tap the Tune button under a message: describe the edit, optionally attach long-term memory and the last few messages as background, and the model API bound to the current chat regenerates the whole passage. The result is aligned per paragraph with the changed parts highlighted inline and a count of added/removed characters; if it comes back identical to the original you are told so. Written back it becomes one more version of that message, so you can switch back to the original with Tavo's native version switching. The panel also offers a thinking mode: pick the switch and level for your model family, or type a raw HTTP body — the parameters travel with that one tuning request only, so your own API settings and normal chat are untouched. The plugin makes no judgement calls for you: how much to change, what to keep and whether to replace are all up to you.
settings.info: Defaults for Dialog Tune. The guiding prompt tells the model how to carry out an edit — rewrite it to match your own writing habits.
settings.showInlineButton.desc: Shows a small Tune button under every message — the most direct way into a message.
settings.defaultUseMemory.desc: Attach the current chat's long-term memory when the panel opens. Your change is remembered for next time.
settings.defaultRecentN.desc: How many messages to attach when the panel opens (taken from before the tuned message). Your change is remembered.
settings.maxRecentN.desc: The highest number you can type in the panel.
settings.guidePrompt.default:
You are a text-editing assistant. Rewrite the passage below according to the player's edit request, and obey:
1. Change only the parts directly related to the request; keep everything else verbatim, including punctuation, line breaks, formatting, forms of address, proper nouns and emotional intensity.
2. Do not add or remove information, do not summarise, do not continue the text, do not comment on it.
3. Keep the original point of view, tense and tone; unless the request says so, do not turn narration into dialogue.
4. Output the complete rewritten passage, with no explanation, preamble, summary or Markdown code fences.
settings.guidePrompt.placeholder: Leave empty to use the default guiding prompt.
settings.guidePrompt.desc: This prompt is placed before the passage and tells the model how to carry out the edit. Edit it to suit your own habits.
settings.autoApply.desc: Skip the before/after view and write back as soon as the result is ready. Off by default.
settings.contentLanguage.desc: Decides which language the rewritten text uses. Defaults to the language of the source.

prompt.memoryBlock:
Below is the chat's long-term memory. It is background only — do not change the passage because of it:

{memory}
</memory>

Below are the recent messages. They are background only — do not change the passage because of them:

{dialogue}
</dialogue>
prompt.outputLanguageSource: Write the output in the same language as the source.
prompt.outputRule: Now output the complete rewritten passage, with no explanation, preamble or code fences.

releaseNotes.1_2_0:
## 1.2.0

User-visible changes since 1.0.10:

**Interface**
- The tuning panel now really sits at the bottom of the chat page. It used to be constrained by the message bubble's container and squeezed under the bubble, almost unusable.
- Removed the "Dialog Tune" entry from the chat page's top-right menu — the button on each bubble and the input box "+" menu remain.
- The inline Tune button is darker and stays legible on both light and dark chat themes.

**Difference highlighting**
- Results are aligned per paragraph and the changed parts are highlighted inline; long messages no longer come back unmarked.
- The result header shows "added N chars / removed M chars", and says so explicitly when the result is identical to the original.
- Added and removed text are highlighted more clearly (bold plus underline).

**Thinking mode (tuning only)**
- Pick a model family and level in the tuning panel, or type a raw HTTP body (for example {"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}}).
- The parameters only travel with that one tuning request — **your own API settings stay untouched** and normal chat is unaffected.
- Manually typed bodies are remembered and reused next time.
- A live elapsed-time indicator while generating.

**Fixes**
- The first tap on "Generate" did nothing after changing the recent-message count.
- Results were lost when the target changed during generation.
- Content was not written back when message variants were unavailable.
- The host panel and the message fragment could not reach each other in some environments.
